Ruling: model error. Triage .transcription/triage/2025/person.json (log sha matches): 4,413/5,015 agree; 428 value, 174 project-refuses; completed: 150 value. The project line is the most that Form 6251 line 2l can add (label: "the line 2l adjustment of Form 6251 is at most this amount"; read by s2.amt_dep for the AMT screen bound). The reply keeps only Form 4562 line 17 (property placed in service before 2025), on the premise that all 2025 property gets the special allowance and so has no adjustment. i6251 p. 5 exempts only qualified property: "The special allowance is deductible for the AMT, and no adjustment is required for any depreciation figured on the remaining basis of the qualified property". 2025 property that is not qualified property and is depreciated under 200% declining balance is still refigured ("Property placed in service after 1998 that is depreciated for the regular tax using the 200% declining balance method"). The interface does not say which line 19 or 26 property is qualified, so a bound must include lines 19a-19d and 26(h). The 150 completed-return values are businesses with 2025 MACRS, where the reply gives a smaller bound. A smaller bound could clear the AMT screen when an adjustment exists. The project line is right as a bound.
